data.name: BAIE Minerals
data.description: BAIE Minerals is a Canadian startup based in Baie Verte, Newfoundland (with a Calgary office) developing technology to process asbestos and ultramafic mine tailings to detoxify waste, extract critical minerals (magnesium oxide, silica), and sequester CO2 via carbon mineralization. The company plans a demonstration project at the Baie Verte community college and was featured in 2025 coverage by Yale E360 and asbestos.com describing heat/acid-based processing of tailings from the former Advocate asbestos mine.
